meta.title: Government / DIB Readiness Register
meta.subtitle: Supplier (SCRM) + Manufacturing & Quality readiness for federal work
meta.principle: ERP runs the operation (transactions, system of record); Mission Control proves the readiness (status, policy, plans, certifications). Each item has one owner; the readiness view references ERP data and never duplicates it.

items.question: Documented sourcing policies for suppliers/subcontractors meeting federal standards
items.note: FAR/DFARS flow-downs, NIST SP 800-161, counterfeit-parts controls

items.question: Assess and monitor quality/performance of suppliers & subcontractors
items.dataSource: ERP: PO / receipt / inspection → supplier scorecards
items.note: On-time delivery, defect rate, corrective actions on a set cadence

items.question: Assess and monitor risk with suppliers/subcontractors
items.dataSource: ERP vendor data + MC risk register
items.note: Financial, single-source, geographic, cyber risk ratings + mitigation

items.question: Assess and monitor supplier/subcontractor scalability constraints if demand increases
items.dataSource: ERP lead-time/PO history + MC surge plan
items.note: Lead times, single-source exposure, second-source / surge planning

items.question: Assess and monitor subcontractors handling FCI/CUI for required CMMC level
items.note: DFARS 252.204-7012 flow-down; verify each sub's CMMC level

items.question: Manufacturing management in place to plan and run production
items.artifact: MC Production Control (production.html) — work orders + routing/WIP + quality (NCR/CAPA/FAI)
items.note: ADDRESSED 2026-08-09: lightweight production-control increment live — plan via work orders, run via routing/WIP, quality via NCR/CAPA/first-article. BOM = future enhancement.

items.question: Working Quality Management System
items.dataSource: ERP quality records (future) + MC QMS status
items.note: AS9100D/ISO 9001-aligned operating QMS; certification is the target

items.question: Quality assurance certifications maintained
items.note: CMMC in progress via Atomus; AS9100D is the target QMS cert; FAA license held
